description: Get the changes/diffs of a merge request (merge_request_iid or source_branch required). To find resources, use the matching list or search tool.

excluded_file_patterns.description: Array of regex patterns to exclude files from the diff results. Each pattern is an RE2 regular expression that matches file paths to ignore. RE2 runs in linear time but does not support lookahead, lookbehind, or backreferences. At most 50 patterns of at most 200 characters each. Examples: ["^vendor/", "^test/mocks/", "\.spec\.ts$", "package-lock\.json"]

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

name: get_merge_request_diffs
